title: Producer, Please capability comparison with OBS Studio and Streamlabs Desktop
scope: Internal finite capability inventory for gameplay, podcast and general-production demo planning. Not a claim to enumerate every third-party extension or all product features.
obsBaseline: Official OBS Studio 33.0.1, released October 29; official release and download pages checked 2026-11-19.
streamlabsBaseline: Current official Desktop/product/support pages checked 2026-11-19; Desktop/free, Ultra, Ultra+ and separate services/apps distinguished. No Producer prices or entitlements inferred.
producerBaseline: Current layer/browser evidence and frozen source gates are recorded separately from the prior accepted recording/screen checkpoint. Main 8765 and Standalone Preview 8767 are separate. No physical-device or platform-delivery acceptance is inferred.

statusLegend.locally_verified: Existing implementation with recorded local acceptance; only the explicitly recorded layer is established.
statusLegend.implemented_partial: Working code covers a narrower workflow; the row limitation is part of its status.
statusLegend.external_obs_only: Available through separately configured OBS; not a native Producer feature or full OBS remote editor.
statusLegend.missing: No comparable supported native Producer workflow established in the inspected implementation.
statusLegend.setup_pending: Implementation exists, but provider setup, permissions, identity or external acceptance prevents the corresponding live claim.
statusLegend.implementation_in_progress: Active source work in this phase; not completed, packaged, accepted or demo-ready by this report.

priorityLegend.P0: Current demo slice requiring completed local acceptance.
priorityLegend.P1: Core workflow or material claim boundary.
priorityLegend.P3: Optional ecosystem/distribution expansion; no automatic authorization.

demoLegend.safe_local: Use previously accepted local media, scene Preview/Take, settings and simulated/isolated Rehearsal only within current authorization. locally_verified is not permission to activate hardware/output.
demoLegend.setup_only: Show configured controls/drafts and truthful blockers; do not imply provider write, grant, receipt or remote identity.
demoLegend.not_ready: Missing/in-progress features may be discussed but not demonstrated as working.
demoLegend.external_obs: Clearly name OBS as the device/encoder owner and explain the limited Producer adapter.

todayFocus.demo: Scene Preview/Take, six-source layer editing, flat groups, center rotation, saved-scene recall, native MKV recording and reviewed replay import followed by an explicit fade Take are locally exercised.
todayFocus.remaining: Physical game/window/audio acceptance, dedicated game hooks, application audio, global hotkeys, flip, nested scenes and real platform receipt remain separate.

todayFocus.demo: Invited guests, waiting-room/backstage chat, generated-media mix-minus and one-mix recording retain their recorded acceptance. Viewer message cards/platform icons and reply composer are separate from backstage conversation.
todayFocus.remaining: Current provider grants and actual replies, physical listening/echo, isolated stems and StackThis producer identity remain separate.

todayFocus.demo: Images/video/text/browser sources, custom layer crop/opacity/rotation, flat group transforms, smart layouts and manual replay playout have the explicitly recorded local evidence.
todayFocus.remaining: Anchors, flip, group/scene nesting, Program filter racks, dual native canvas, provider permissions, final combined build and current-phase Preview activation remain separate. Main-profile promotion is not claimed.

rows.feature: Free position, scale and anchor transforms
rows.streamlabs: Desktop: source transform editing.
rows.limit: Six-source custom maps support numeric/pointer/keyboard position and size, flat named group move/resize and per-layer center rotation. Group transforms update all member boxes atomically and reject locked members or invalid bounds. Drafts require Apply to Preview and separate exact-ID Take. Anchor editing and nested scene graphs remain absent.

rows.streamlabs: Desktop: source transform/crop controls.
rows.limit: Per-source crop, opacity and center rotation from -180 to 180 degrees are locally exercised, including actual clockwise/counterclockwise pixels and crop plus opacity. Both bus maps and saved scenes preserve rotation/group membership. Flip and a general bounds/anchor editor remain absent. Group selection transforms the axis-aligned member boxes; rotation remains per layer.

rows.limit: Custom stack order, visual-only Hide, edit Lock and Reset are locally exercised with scene preservation/recall. Hidden sources retain availability/decode requirements; Hide does not mute audio and Lock does not freeze video. New flat group changes also respect member locks. Actual dark/light 1920/390 controls and bounds were checked.

rows.streamlabs: Desktop: scene/source composition; exact grouping behavior depends on build.
rows.limit: Flat named groups within the existing six-source composition support Group/Ungroup and atomic move/resize while preserving member crop, opacity, order, visibility and rotation. Any locked member or invalid result blocks the whole operation. Membership survives scene save/recall. Nested scenes, group nesting and parent/group rotation are not implemented.

rows.streamlabs: Free Desktop: replay buffer and Instant Replay source.
rows.limit: Native replay retains H.264 and one Live AAC mix in a 120 MiB encoded ring plus one save snapshot, targeting 15/30/60 seconds; capacity can shorten history. Explicit MKV Save is followed by a separately reviewed Load replay into Preview, which creates a browser-compatible MP4 library copy without changing the original MKV or Program. Actual packaged core acceptance verifies silent decoded Preview at zero, duplicate import protection, visible Video & text entry and explicit fade Take starting playback from the beginning with advancing time. Seven generated files decode and streaming/recording/replay Stop independently. No automatic Take/loop, isolated stems or VOD mix; hardware, platform receipt and endurance remain unverified.
